high_ESS_missing_mode_counterexample.iid_probability_scope: Probability for hypothetical independent uniform draws, not this deterministic realization.
high_ESS_missing_mode_counterexample.interpretation: Maximum ESS within visited support coexists with a missed event carrying about half the true posterior mass.

same_measure_coordinate_transform.interpretation: Keeping the Jacobian preserves one probability measure; replacing it by a uniform transformed-coordinate prior changes the measure.

radius_uniform_vs_volume_uniform.likelihood: L(r)=1+4*r^2 (positive analytic toy likelihood, no physical response)
radius_uniform_vs_volume_uniform.volume: V proportional to r^3; uniform V induces density 3*r^2
radius_uniform_vs_volume_uniform.interpretation: This compares genuinely different radius and volume priors, not two coordinate representations of one prior.

deterministic_event_partition_and_remain.tie_rule: descending mass, stable original event order

top_k.unmodeled_geometry_status: Broader physical model not defined: mass unquantified; outside this 3-template prior is excluded by prior, not ruled out by data
top_k.event: each discrete fixed-geometry topology with its whole continuous complex-permittivity region

deterministic_event_partition_and_remain.interpretation: Displayed events retain their unconditional modeled masses. The omitted modeled event has quantified mass; a broader unspecified physical model has unquantified mass. Support exclusion is a prior choice.

saved_complete_case_moment_quantile_cohe.necessary_condition: For exact quantiles of one law: Var(X)>=.05*(mu-q05)_+^2+.05*(q95-mu)_+^2. Median bins give additional nonnegative lower-bound terms.
saved_complete_case_moment_quantile_cohe.quantile_convention: generalized-inverse CDF quantiles; the tests apply if the reported values are interpreted as exact quantiles
saved_complete_case_moment_quantile_cohe.interpretation: Violations identify incompatible approximate moment/CDF summaries. No detected violation is not certification. Refinement differences are descriptive; neither saved summary is an exact reference. This is not a likelihood-normalization failure.
